newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Telecom closes mortgage-backed FRN.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom closes mortgage-backed FRN.

text.p: HongKong Telecommunications' HK$800 million staff housing mortgages securities was launched and closed in the form of a floating rate note issue, the mandated arranger Societe Generale Group said on Thursday.
The notes will mature in 2019, and pay an interest margin of 60 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
The expected average life is estimated at 3-1/2 to four years.
The securitisation will take effect through Hong Kong Mortgage Financing Co, a special purpose vehicle incorporated in Jersey, the Channel Island.
Net proceeds will be used to finance Hongkong Telecom's portfolio of staff mortgages.
The notes will be without recourse to HongKong Telecom and the mortgage loan portfolio will continue to be administered by the HongKong Telecom Group.
The notes will be guaranteed 100 percent by AAA-rated MBIA Assurance S.A on the timely payment of interest and ultimate repayment of principal.
The notes are expected to be rated AAAr by Standard and Poor's Corp and Aaa by Mood's Investors Services.
Societe Generale Asia is the lead manager.
Co-managers are BA Asia, Bear Stearn Asia, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Goldman Sachs, HSBC Markets, Merrill Lynch, Salomon Brothers, and Westpac Banking Corp.
